name: Shea Butter
description: Shea butter is a natural, fat-rich substance derived from the nuts of the shea tree. It has been used for centuries in traditional African skincare and haircare practices due to its moisturizing and healing properties.
benefits_skin: Heals dry, irritated, or damaged skin
benefits_hair: Protects against heat damage from styling tools
Reduces dandruff and soothes scalp irritation
best_for: Scalp conditions such as dryness, dandruff, or flakiness
Hair that is prone to breakage or split ends
avoid_for: Individuals with nut allergies (since shea butter contains nuts)
Those who have allergic reactions to shea butter in the past
how_to_use: Apply a small amount directly onto skin for moisturizing
Massage into hair before styling or use as a deep conditioning treatment
Can be mixed with other oils for facial application
Use on dry patches such as elbows, knees, and heels
scientific_evidence: Several studies have shown the effectiveness of shea butter in skin and hair care, particularly for its moisturizing properties. Research indicates that it contains compounds like fatty acids and vitamins A and E, which contribute to its skin healing and anti-aging benefits.
